The failures escalate: #1236 shows PutObject failing with 500 InternalError, #1258 shows the aws-sdk retry quota exhausted (45 failed attempts in 60s), and #1341 shows a 503 ServiceUnavailable. The gateway and ingest-api 500s are downstream symptoms of the enrichment/S3 failure.
